title: SDK & API adoption activation templates for function calls, structured outputs, and streaming
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Ship a reusable "activation kit" that accelerates customer adoption of the new SDK + API surface (function calling, structured output, streaming). The activation kit should include: 1) a short runbook for engineering/product partners to configure SDKs, 2) three battle-tested sample apps (chat with function calls, structured JSON output extraction, high-throughput streaming consumer), 3) copy-ready release notes and snippet blocks for docs and changelogs, 4) a QA checklist and gating criteria for compatibility and graceful fallback.

Scope: Templates and sample code for Node, Python, and Go SDKs; release-note stencils for Console, Changelogs, and Marketplace; a rollout checklist for staged enablement (internal beta -> public beta -> GA); and a one-page enablement checklist for Solutions and Sales. We will not ship engineered client libraries in this ticket (that is ENG scope) — this ticket covers PM-owned content, sample mapping, and go-to-market coordination.

Success metrics: adoption lift measured by feature-flag opt-ins (target +20% in first 30 days), number of sample forks/stars (>=500 across repos), and a <10% support contact rate for onboarding issues in first two weeks.

Deliverables: activation-runbook.md (confluence), 3 sample repos with README and CI, release-note templates (short/expanded), a staged rollout matrix (internal beta dates + public beta), enablement slide deck for Solutions, and a mini-postmortem template for GA lessons.

Risks & mitigations: 1) Engineering delays on streaming endpoints — mitigate by shipping a mock streaming consumer sample that works with local test harness until server changes land. 2) Docs inconsistencies — include an automated snippet extractor (docsbot) in CI to prevent drift. 3) Breaking changes for large customers — require canary gating + contact list; Product will own communications.

Stakeholders: Docs (Priya Rao), DevRel (Jonas Müller), SDK Eng leads (Anita Gomez for Node/Python, Kofi Mensah for Go), Solutions (Rhea Singh), Sales enablement (Evan Brooks), Legal & Security (for marketing copy review).

Rollout plan highlights:
- 2025-02-24: internal dev-only pilot + samples reviewed by ENGS + Docs (done)
- 2025-03-03: external beta to selected customers + Solutions enablement (target)
- 2025-03-14: GA content freeze & release-note publish (target)

Artifacts & links: Confluence activation doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/SDK-activation-kit (draft), Samples staging repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-activation-kit (private), Draft release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432
